readme:
# This account

This is the social account of a poker training app. Its posts go out in fixed time slots through the platform behind the `sim` command; `sim catalog` describes what it offers. There is no money to spend here: the account can post three times a day.

Ticks run for you every 12 hours.

To reach me, run `notify`; `notify --help` says how it works.

This account has no Google access; keep the hill climb's workbook as CSV files in `workbook/`.

Reports for me go in `reports/` as HTML or Markdown files.
setup_prompt: /hill-climb Set up a hill climb on this account's posts to get as many follows per post as possible.
